name: Poly Etchant
description: Poly Etchant is a mixed acid solution of hydrofluoric acid and nitric acid designed for selective wet etching of polycrystalline silicon (poly-Si) thin films in semiconductor manufacturing. The HNO3 component oxidizes the silicon surface while HF dissolves the resulting silicon dioxide, enabling continuous and controlled removal of polysilicon layers. This formulation is used for patterning polysilicon gate electrodes, interconnects, and structural layers in MEMS devices. The etch rate and selectivity can be tuned by adjusting the HF-to-HNO3 ratio and process temperature. Poly Etchant provides isotropic etching characteristics suitable for bulk polysilicon removal and device fabrication processes.
physicalProperties: Appearance: clear colorless liquid; Density: ~1.2 g/cm³; pH: <1; Boiling Point: >100 °C
